title: 第3章 燕归城陈家第4章 陈家陈长安
slug: 开局长生不死谁都以为我无敌
lines: 第3章燕归城，陈家大周国
北原郡
燕归城，陈家
“陈家主，今日我们柳家登门拜访，已是给了你们天大的颜面。”
“我劝你还是要好自为之，真当你们还是当年的陈家不成？”
柳家人的话，让陈家所有人的表情都变得异常愤怒。
当真是虎落平阳被犬欺！
陈家原本并非大周国之人，当年不过是迁徙来到大周。
曾经的陈家在大周国可是当之无愧的第一世家，而这柳家呢？不过是陈家的附庸而已！
凭借着陈家的帮衬，柳家迅速崛起，为此，柳家更是立下了一个规矩！
柳家世代家主之女，都要嫁入陈家。
柳家本是为了表忠心，却不曾想，陈家竟然也有落败的一天。
原本还能算得上是北原郡第一家族，可近百年以来，竟然沦落到了在这燕归城龟缩的地步。
陈家还是北原郡第一家族之时，柳家多少还和陈家有些来往，可当柳家顺利成为大周国三大家族之一那一刻，就彻底断了联系。
没曾想这一次柳家的人竟然会登门拜访，这着实出乎了陈家其他人的意料。
本打算热情款待一番，然而柳家人的态度，却着实有些过分。
“柳乘风，你我两家已经百年没有交集。”
“你大可不必特意跑来一趟，难不成，就是为了羞辱我陈家一番吗？”
“至于你们柳家当年立下来的规矩，你们本可以自己做主。”
“何必来此咄咄逼人？”
陈家家主陈正元，并没有因为双方如今地位悬殊，便选择忍气吞声！
柳乘风同样有些惊讶，没想到陈家已经落魄至此，竟然还有些火气？
只不过，这没有任何实力的火气，在柳乘风看来，不过是一个笑话罢了！
“哼，我家大小姐，如今被上清宗看重，又和大周皇室五皇子情投意合，你们……”
“族叔。”
柳乘风还未说完，便被一旁的一位年轻女子开口阻拦。
“还是我来说吧。”
柳梦妍便是如今柳家当代家主之女，按照柳家当年的规矩，也是应该嫁入到陈家之人。
只不过，这个规矩在陈家看来，早就已经作废了，毕竟柳家很早之前就不再和陈家往来。
所以他们的登门拜访，让陈家感觉莫名其妙。
看得出来，柳梦妍在柳家的地位很高，她一句话，柳乘风这个族叔便拖至一旁不再言语。
柳梦妍看向陈正元，微微一笑，说道“陈家主，当年我们柳家也曾经得到过陈家不少恩惠。”

Chapter 3 Yan returns to the city, the Chen family conquers the Zhou Kingdom
Beiyuan County
Yangui City, Chen Family
"Master Chen, our Liu family's visit today has given you great honor."
"I advise you to take care of yourself. Do you really think that you are still the same Chen family as before?"
The words of the Liu family made everyone in the Chen family look extremely angry.
It's really like a tiger being bullied by a dog!
The Chen family was not originally from the Great Zhou Kingdom, they just migrated to the Great Zhou Kingdom.
The Chen family used to be the well-deserved number one family in the Great Zhou Kingdom, but what about the Liu family? He is just a vassal of the Chen family!
With the help of the Chen family, the Liu family rose rapidly. To this end, the Liu family even set a rule!
The daughters of the heads of the Liu family for generations have to marry into the Chen family.
The Liu family originally wanted to show their loyalty, but they never thought that the Chen family would also be defeated one day.
Originally, it could be regarded as the first family in Beiyuan County, but in the past hundred years, it has been reduced to the point of shrinking in Yangui City.
When the Chen family was still the first family in Beiyuan County, the Liu family had some contact with the Chen family. However, when the Liu family successfully became one of the three major families in the Great Zhou Kingdom, the contact was completely severed.
They never thought that someone from the Liu family would come to visit this time, which was really beyond the expectations of the other Chen family.
I planned to treat him warmly, but the Liu family's attitude was a bit too much.
"Liu Chengfeng, your family and I haven't met each other for a hundred years."
"You don't have to go all the way here. Is it possible that you just want to humiliate my Chen family?"
"As for the rules established by your Liu family back then, you could have made the decision yourself."
"Why come here to be aggressive?"
Chen Zhengyuan, the head of the Chen family, did not choose to swallow his anger just because of the disparity in status between the two parties!
Liu Chengfeng was also a little surprised. He didn't expect that the Chen family was already in such a state of decline that they would still be angry?
However, this anger without any strength is just a joke in Liu Chengfeng's opinion!
"Humph, my eldest lady is now valued by the Shangqing Sect, and she is in love with the fifth prince of the Zhou royal family. You..."
"Uncle Clan."
Before Liu Chengfeng could finish speaking, he was stopped by a young woman on the side.
"Let me tell you."
Liu Mengyan is the daughter of the current head of the Liu family. According to the rules of the Liu family back then, she should also be married into the Chen family.
However, in the Chen family's opinion, this rule has long been invalidated. After all, the Liu family stopped communicating with the Chen family a long time ago.
So their visit made the Chen family feel baffled.
It was obvious that Liu Mengyan had a very high status in the Liu family. With just one word from her, Liu Chengfeng, the uncle of the family, was dragged aside and said nothing.
Liu Mengyan looked at Chen Zhengyuan, smiled slightly, and said, "Master Chen, our Liu family also received a lot of favors from the Chen family back then."
